read_only_root_cause: The frozen distribution RECORD hashes were computed from raw file bytes. Controller v1 used importlib.metadata.distribution(...).read_text("RECORD").encode(), which normalized CRLF to LF. absl-py RECORD raw SHA matched the manifest; text-normalized SHA did not. The same mismatch was observed in the first eight package records.
disposition: No retry. v1 authorization permanently consumed. Versioned v2 controller and manifest require separate review and new authorization before any target execution.
